record.title: The concentrations of the inflammatory markers the amino-terminal portion of C-type pronatriuretic peptide and procalcitonin in canine babesiosis caused by Babesia canis.
record.journal: Hrčak Portal of scientific journals of Croatia (University Computing Centre)

screening.species: B. canis (confirmed per authors; method not stated)
screening.rationale: Based on the Hrčak landing page abstract (Vet Arhiv 84(6):575-589, 2014): 72 dogs with babesiosis vs 25 controls. PCT differed between infected and healthy dogs, and NT-proCNP differed between survivors and non-survivors, so these are host inflammatory and prognostic markers.
